entities.summary: Madhan Karky Vairamuthu is an Indian lyricist, screenwriter, research associate, software engineer, and entrepreneur. A holder of a doctorate in computer science from the University of Queensland, Karky began his professional career as an assistant professor at the College of Engineering, Guindy, and soon after ventured into the Tamil cinema, working as a lyricist and dialogue writer. He resigned from his teaching profession in early 2013 and began working full-time in the film industry, while also launching the Karky Research Foundation (KaReFo), an educational research organization which primarily focuses on language computing and language literacy.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent figure in Tamil cinema and language computing, Madhan Karky's work has contributed to the preservation of India's linguistic diversity through his research and writing. His foundation has also provided educational resources for underprivileged communities.
